adapter.note: Ordered prev<i variant, no counters. Exact bitplane pricing includes predecessor and carry metadata. Public initial/final memory matches Twist. GF128 GP bound is size dependent; no equal overall security claim.

adaptations: F192 -> existing OM polynomial-basis GF128 with two packed carryless lanes; field modulus and representation unchanged
Three-tree fixed batch -> two-tree fixed batch; both roots are transcript-bound, outer permutation verifier checks equality
leanVM proof transport -> labelled OM Transcript with bound dimensions and roots; same normalized quartic equality recurrence without divisions
Scalar native schedule -> Rayon disjoint output windows; donor parallel threshold 2^11, fused 64-pair tiles and recycled uninitialized output allocations
Known identity ranges and implicit suffix retained; structural suffix trimmed while original logical extent is checked; no content-based merging
Joint fours/sixteens preparation plus a production from_fn_pair API generating both trees and both prepared levels in one tiled pass
AVX512 F192 vertical kernels and non-temporal Stream stores not ported; OM native AVX2/VPCLMUL helpers used
Independent full binary-tree/schoolbook coefficient oracle verifies exact GF128 proof messages, terminal MLEs and Fiat-Shamir continuation
Benchmark-only thin harness compiles byte-identical original three-tree source with actual pinned GF192 primitives, custom pool and transcript; cross-field/batch timings explicitly labelled
lean_grandproduct.reference_files: Byte-identical pinned upstream sources retained under reference/; they are not compiled.

jolt.use: Two-pass common-cycle claim reduction, shared-Eq flat virtualization, compact lazy selectors and per-row arithmetic product tree; adapted to GF128 coefficient arithmetic.

leanVM.use: Algorithm/scheduling reference; GF192 representation and protocols are not substituted.

sharing_policy.onehot: Explicit source identity and matching chunk index only; no witness-content comparisons.
sharing_policy.shared_ram: Adapter supplies a declared shared-address alias; read and write references are canonicalized.
sharing_policy.virtualization: Explicit source identity and matching address point only; no witness-content comparisons.

open_magnetar.stage14_api_note: The existing Eq-factor Cofactor/Endpoint/prove kernel is exported for the ordered Spice comparison. Existing Twist/Shout kernels and proof formats are unchanged.
open_magnetar.workspace_note: Cargo.toml selects eight upstream crates. Cargo.lock is resolved for this subset; neither workspace file is a prover kernel.

notes: Every warmup/measured proof independently verified; identical initial/access trace and exact final memory checked across methods.
Inclusive commit/open are reconstructed from the exclusive PCS span partition; IOP+prep includes preparation, argument and unattributed time. Derived sample totals are medianed independently.
Spice commits access/final predecessors and ripple carries; all component area and final Mosaic padding are reported. Initial/final memory are public and transcript-bound.

Current GP field is GF128. Its (T+N)/2^128 term and other errors prevent inferring equal/composed 120-bit security from the inherited PCS profile. Larger-field GP requires a separately authenticated extension opening adapter.
